text: The Motorex lubricants brand belongs to the MOTOREX-BUCHER GROUP AG of Langenthal, Switzerland, which describes itself as an independent family business with MOTOREX AG as parent company of its operating subsidiaries.
short: Motorex is an independent Swiss family business (MOTOREX-BUCHER GROUP).

source.name: MOTOREX: Company
source.quote: The MOTOREX-BUCHER GROUP AG continues to operate as an independent family business
